cards.back: A group of 10 ones. Ten ones can be swapped for one ten.
cards.say: What is a ten? A group of ten ones. Ten ones can be swapped for one ten.
Ten ones make how many tens? One ten.
Eleven is made of one ten and one one. Ten plus one equals eleven.
Twelve is made of one ten and two ones. Ten plus two equals twelve.
Thirteen is made of one ten and three ones. Ten plus three equals thirteen.
Fourteen is made of one ten and four ones. Ten plus four equals fourteen.

figure.alt: One tens rod and four single ones cubes make fourteen.

cards.say: Fifteen is made of one ten and five ones. Ten plus five equals fifteen.
Sixteen is made of one ten and six ones. Ten plus six equals sixteen.
Seventeen is made of one ten and seven ones. Ten plus seven equals seventeen.
Eighteen is made of one ten and eight ones. Ten plus eight equals eighteen.
Nineteen is made of one ten and nine ones. Ten plus nine equals nineteen.

cards.front: 20 is made of how many tens?
cards.say: Twenty is made of how many tens? Two tens and zero ones.
One ten and six ones make sixteen.
Ten plus five equals fifteen.

cards.front: Which digit shows the ones in 18?
cards.back: 8. The 1 is the ten and the 8 is the ones.
cards.say: Which digit shows the ones in eighteen? Eight. The one is the ten and the eight is the ones.

cards.back: 18. It has more ones after the ten.
cards.say: Which is more, thirteen or eighteen? Eighteen. It has more ones after the ten.

cards.back: 9. 12 has a whole ten and 9 does not.
cards.say: Which is less, nine or twelve? Nine. Twelve has a whole ten and nine does not.
Which is the smallest number: fifteen, eleven or nineteen? Eleven.
One more than nineteen is twenty.
Ten plus ten equals twenty. Two tens make twenty.
Put in order, smallest first: seventeen, twelve, fifteen. Twelve, fifteen, seventeen.
One less than eleven is ten.
